name: The Big Con

pick.label: Pick a fake
pick.heading: Pick something to fake and pitch the film
lead: Everybody loves a con artist film: the charming liar, the clever plan, the people with lots of money and little sense who fall for it, and the twist at the end.
A film studio wants the next one, and you're pitching it. Pick something your con artist is going to fake. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *Nobody real gets hurt: it's only a film.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: Obviously I'm not looking for a real criminal plan here (please don't), this is just for a bit of fun. The sillier the con, the better the film.

values.title: Three Stars and a Spatula
values.hero: Gregor, 41, runs a Currywurst stand by Warschauer Straße and is deeply offended that no food critic has ever written about it. Always wears a chef's hat, even on the U-Bahn.
values.plan: He has a very convincing plaque made, puts a secret tasting menu online at €290 a head (it's Currywurst with gold leaf on top), and pays his cousin to pretend to be a French food critic. Within a week, half of Mitte is queueing.
values.twist: The 'French critic' turns out to be a real restaurant inspector who genuinely loves the Currywurst. Nobody is sure whether that counts as a happy ending.
values.starring: Lars Eidinger as Gregor, Sandra Hüller as the cousin. The role of the Currywurst is still being cast.
